label: Bible Study
prompt: It is good that a man should both hope and _____ wait for the salvation of the LORD.
verse: It is good that a man should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
note: Written over Jerusalem's ruins — hope that waits quietly, without demanding a timetable.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be _____.
verse: These things have I spoken unto you, that my joy might remain in you, and that your joy might be full.
note: Jesus wants His joy in you not as a sample but as a full measure.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon _____ wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
verse: And there came an angel of the LORD, and sat under an oak which was in Ophrah, that pertained unto Joash the Abiezrite: and his son Gideon threshed wheat by the winepress, to hide it from the Midianites.
note: Gideon was threshing wheat down in a winepress to hide it — not exactly where you'd expect a mighty man of valour.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and _____ it before the LORD.
verse: And Hezekiah received the letter of the hand of the messengers, and read it: and Hezekiah went up into the house of the LORD, and spread it before the LORD.
note: Hezekiah got Assyria's threatening letter and spread it out before God in the temple.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Brethren, if a man be _____ in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
verse: Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness; considering thyself, lest thou also be tempted.
note: If someone is 'overtaken in a fault,' restore him gently — and check yourself while you're at it.
